body.x: AeroVironment(www.evsolutions.com) unveiled ‘TurboDock’ that charges an electronic car at ‘Digital Experience!’ which ran Jan. 5 in Las Vegas. 'Digital Experience!' is an annual event only for media, held by Pepcom before the opening of CES. At the event, more than 1,500 journalists had a time to cover CES opening ceremony and startup products in advance.AeroVironment’s TurboDock is the world’s smallest and lightest plug-in charger of electronic car. Placement fee is low and networking commission is free so that it’s possible to control it through smartphone application economically. Users can charge their car rapidly and easily.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.→ Go to 'CES 2016' News page
